desc: Parse input: N and the list A of length N-1.
Factorize each A_i using primes up to 1000 to collect per-prime exponent lists a_i = v_p(A_i).
For each prime p, compute H = sum of a_i, precompute p^k mod MOD for k=0..H.

Run DP: arrays touch[h] and notouch[h] initialized to 0; start with e1=0, touched=1, value=1 (since min must be 0, the walk must start at 0; handle initial step by enumerating up/down a_1 from 0 and updating touched accordingly).
For each step i=2..N-1, update touch and notouch for new heights h±a_i within [0,H], multiplying by p^{new_h} and OR-ing the touched flag.
After processing all steps, per-prime contribution = sum of touch[h] for h=0..H; if no positive a_i, contribution=1.
Multiply all per-prime contributions mod 998244353 and output.
